source.reference: CWE-200 via the standard soft-delete omission: the write path sets the tombstone and a read path is left unfiltered

defect: deleteNote sets deleted_at, but listNotes still returns every row, so a deleted note stays visible.
why_it_is_hard: listNotes is not in the diff. The change is complete and correct in isolation; the defect is a file it did not touch, which the reviewer only sees by opening the reader for a writer it just changed.
